behavior.read: Current phone status accepts a live saved/refreshed session without requiring authentication younger than 15 minutes; GET makes no profile writes
behavior.change: Mutations require recent authentication; for phone accounts an inline existing-number OTP refreshes the same account session without logout; legacy email accounts use existing email authentication
behavior.newNumber: Canonical Iraqi mobile number, OTP with expiry/attempt/cooldown and sender limits; reject current number and number belonging to another identity/profile/reservation
behavior.identity: Keep Cognito subject and original profile userId, orders and canonical wallet owner; no account recreation or balance mutations
behavior.reauthOwnerFence: Bound existing phone entry is read-only; reject mismatched account response before replacing saved OTP session; fence network results and verify return by owner
behavior.sync: Modern canonical profiles plus legacy email and phone-only profiles resolved from verified server identity; request cannot select userId
behavior.recovery: Claim challenge, subject pending marker and target reservation together. Keep pending operation and active pointer without TTL until finalized. Existing authenticated owner can resume only the same fixed target if network/profile finalization fails. Completed retry is idempotent. Alias collision cleans pending marker and target reservation. Old number reservation released only for same subject.
behavior.loginDuringPending: Do not issue fresh login tokens or initialize wallet while phone-change marker is present; existing session can complete operation
behavior.UI: Current number card, explain security proof, separate new number/code steps, clear errors and resume action; removed wallet-transfer-only copy
